# typeassert: match in switch case
typeassert {
	var i I
	i.Kind() == 1 -> i.(T1)
	i.Kind() == 2 -> i.(T2)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type I interface {
	Kind() int
	Do()
}

type T1 struct{}
func (T1) Kind() int { return 1 }
func (T1) Do()       {}

type T2 struct{}
func (T2) Kind() int { return 2 }
func (T2) Do()       {}

func F(x I) {
	switch x.Kind() {
	case 1:
		x.Do()
	case 2:
		x.Do()
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,18 +6,22 @@
 }

+

 func (T2) Do()       {}

 func F(x I) {
 	switch x.Kind() {
 	case 1:
+		x := x.(T1)
 		x.Do()
 	case 2:
+		x := x.(T2)
 		x.Do()
 	}
 }
